1325.desc_zh: 最大生命減少[數值]。造成額外[數值]真實傷害。
1325.desc_en: Reduce max Health by [數值]. Deal an extra [數值] damage as true damage.

1326.desc_zh: 對敵方英雄造成傷害後，在[數值]秒內參與擊殺他們，會增加跑速，並讓你進入隱形狀態。
1326.desc_en: Takedowns against enemy champions within [數值] seconds of damaging them grants you Movement Speed and renders you invisible.

1327.desc_zh: 每次硬控場或禁錮敵軍時，增加物防和魔防。
1327.desc_en: Each time you Immobilize or Ground an enemy, gain Armor and Magic Resist.

1328.desc_zh: 普攻暴擊時會累加攻速。 增加 [數值]暴擊率。
1328.desc_en: Your basic Attack stacks Attack Speed on Critical Strikes. Gain [數值] Crit chance.

1329.desc_zh: 雪球增加[數值]技能加速。 你的雪球超大且會穿過士兵。雪球會緩速、擊飛英雄並造成額外傷害。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
1329.desc_en: Gain [數值] Ability Haste on Snowball. Your snowball is BIG and will pass through minions. It Slows, Knocks Up champions, and deals additional damage. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1331.desc_zh: 增加 [數值]治療量和護盾量。獲得幻焰之誓召喚師技能。 全神貫注 傳送到友軍身旁，抵達時獲得[數值]護盾，持續[數值]秒。
1331.desc_en: Gain [數值] Heal and Shield power. Gain Empyrean Promise as a Summoner Spell. Vigilance Teleport to an ally and grant [數值] Shield for [數值] seconds after landing.

1332.desc_zh: 根據已損失生命獲得魔攻、跑速和全能吸血，每次施放技能都會受到傷害。
1332.desc_en: Gain Ability Power, Movement Speed, and Omnivamp based on missing Health, taking damage each time you cast.

1333.desc_zh: 達到[數值]生命時，獲得大量逐漸衰減的護盾、逐漸衰減的跑速，以及逐漸恢復的縮小效果。
1333.desc_en: Gain a massive decaying Shield, decaying Movement Speed, and a decaying shrink effect upon reaching [數值] Health.

1334.desc_zh: 讓你的雪球獲得[數值]技能加速。命中敵軍時會降雪，造成範圍傷害並使鄰近敵軍緩速。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
1334.desc_en: Gain [數值] Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy creates a snowfall that deals AoE damage and Slows nearby enemies. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1335.desc_zh: 以普攻或技能傷害英雄時，造成額外魔法傷害，並獲得金錢和跑速。
1335.desc_en: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional magic damage, and grants you Gold and Movement Speed.

1336.desc_zh: 獲得500金錢。 持有無盡之刃時，你的暴擊會根據暴擊率造成隨機額外暴擊傷害。
1336.desc_en: Gain 500 Gold. Having Infinity Edge allows your Critical Strike Chance to grant random Critical Strike Damage each Attack.

1337.desc_zh: 首次攜帶傳說道具乘坐敵方傳送門後，你將加冕為王、升級道具，並獲得一件隨機稜鏡增幅裝置。
1337.desc_en: The first time you take the enemy transport with a Legendary Item you become Kinged, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.

1343.desc_zh: 立即：獲得1雙隨機升級版靴子。 條件：完成任務可換另一雙。 獎勵：嘉文一世的靴子
1343.desc_en: Immediate: Gain a random pair of upgraded boots. Requirement: Complete its quest to swap for another. Reward: Jarvan I's Boot

1344.desc_zh: 施放大絕後，獲得最大生命護盾、全能吸血以及跑速，持續[數值]秒。
1344.desc_en: After casting your Ultimate, gain a max Health Shield, Omnivamp and Movement Speed for [數值] seconds.

1345.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時會產生爆炸，使鄰近敵軍緩速[數值]，並根據其當前生命造成傷害。
1345.desc_en: On takedown, creates an explosion that slows other nearby enemies by [數值], and deals damage based on their current Health.

1346.desc_zh: 你無法接受友軍治療，也無法獲得生命回復。獲得[數值]全能吸血。
1346.desc_en: You cannot be healed by allies or gain Health Regen. Gain [數值] Omnivamp.

1347.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能「搗蛋鬼」。 「搗蛋鬼」可施放「光盾」和「鬼步」。
1347.desc_en: Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell. Poltergeist casts both Barrier and Ghost.

1348.desc_zh: 獲得第二次閃現召喚師技能和[數值]召喚師技能加速。
1348.desc_en: Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and [數值] Summoner Haste.

1349.desc_zh: 增加[數值]大絕加速。 施放大絕後，重置基礎技能並增加[數值]基礎技能加速，持續[數值]秒(冷卻時間[數值]秒)。
1349.desc_en: Gain [數值] Ultimate Ability Haste. After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain [數值] basic ability haste for [數值]s. ([數值]s Cooldown)

1353.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時獲得一層堆層，可增加體型和最大生命。死亡時失去層數。
1353.desc_en: On takedown, gain a stack that increases your size and max Health. Lose stacks on death.

1356.desc_zh: 暴擊時，會發射飛彈，造成魔法傷害。 增加 [數值]暴擊率。
1356.desc_en: When you Critically Strike, fire missiles dealing magic damage. Gain [數值] Crit chance.

1358.desc_zh: 你的雪球獲得技能加速，且會造成額外真實傷害。 雪球碰到牆體反彈時，體積和傷害會增加，並縮短冷卻時間。
1358.desc_en: Your Snowball gains Ability Haste and deals extra True Damage. When the Snowball bounces off walls, it increases in size and damage and has a reduced Cooldown.

1361.desc_zh: 立即獲得一個巴米灰燼。 任務：持有日炎聖盾和虛偽光彩。 獎勵：這些道具能合成虛空獻祭。
1361.desc_en: Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder. QUEST: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance. REWARD: These Items combine into Void Immolation.

1373.desc_zh: 參與擊殺會使體型變小，並賦予技能加速及跑速。 死亡時失去[數值]堆層。
1373.desc_en: Takedowns makes you smaller and grant Ability Haste and Movement Speed. Lose [數值] stacks on death.

1375.desc_zh: 對敵方英雄造成硬控場後，獲得[數值]最大生命。 若這是你拿的第二件增幅裝置，開始時有[數值]生命。
1375.desc_en: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants [數值] max Health. If taken as your second Augment, starts with [數值] Health.

1379.desc_zh: 增加[數值]攻速。 你對敵方英雄進行普攻時，破曉綻放之劍的治療效果提升至[數值]。
1379.desc_en: Gain [數值] Attack Speed. Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to [數值] when you attack enemy champions.

1384.desc_zh: 獲得[數值]金錢。別問那麼多。
1384.desc_en: Get [數值] Gold. No questions asked.

1386.desc_zh: 英勇勾索取代一個召喚師技能。 施放英勇勾索會發射鉤爪嵌入地形，重施技能可以擺蕩繞過地形。擺蕩時會自動普攻最靠近的敵軍。若撞上敵方英雄或重施技能，就會結束擺盪。
1386.desc_en: Replace a Summoner Spell with Heroic Swing. Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook, sticking into terrain, after which you can Recast to swing around it. While swinging, automatically Attack the nearest enemy. Colliding with an enemy champion or Recasting ends the swing.

1388.desc_zh: 增加[數值]技能加速，每次參與擊殺則額外增加[數值]技能加速。
1388.desc_en: Gain [數值] Ability Haste, plus [數值] Ability Haste per takedown.

1389.desc_zh: 增加[數值]適性之力。大幅強化鄰近友軍士兵。
1389.desc_en: Gain [數值] Adaptive Force. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.

1390.desc_zh: 使用技能對敵方英雄造成傷害後，可永久增加[數值]魔攻。 若這是你拿的第二件增幅裝置，開始時有[數值]魔攻。
1390.desc_en: Permanently gain [數值] Ability Power when you damage enemy champions with Abilities. If taken as your second Augment, starts with [數值] Ability Power.

1392.desc_zh: 雪球增加[數值]技能加速。 使用雪球衝刺時，短暫進入無敵狀態。 若你沒有雪球就會獲得一顆雪球。
1392.desc_en: Gain [數值] Ability Haste on Snowball. You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1401.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能「急遽成長」。 「急遽成長」會使你體型瞬間變大，擊飛鄰近敵軍並賦予你最大生命。
1401.desc_en: Gain Growth Spurt as a Summoner Spell. Growth Spurt suddenly increases your size, Knocking Up nearby enemies and granting max Health.

1402.desc_zh: 獲得[數值]個能力值鐵砧，並有較高機會是黃金或稜鏡鐵砧！ 下次選擇增幅裝置時，每個欄位可額外重抽一次。
1402.desc_en: Gain [數值] Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils! On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.

1403.desc_zh: 獲得[數值]個能力值鐵砧，並有較高機會是黃金或稜鏡鐵砧！
1403.desc_en: Gain [數值] Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

1404.desc_zh: 獲得[數值]塊能力值鐵砧！

1413.desc_zh: 施放大絕後，嘲諷鄰近敵軍並賦予自身傷害減免。 獲得[數值]大絕技能加速。
1413.desc_en: Using your Ultimate Taunts nearby enemies and grants you damage reduction. Gain [數值] Ultimate Ability Haste.

1415.desc_zh: 造成技能傷害時，發射1+[數值]枚飛彈，每一枚造成[數值]魔法傷害。 增加 [數值]暴擊率。
1415.desc_en: On ability damage, fire 1 plus [數值] missiles that deal [數值] magic damage each. Gain [數值] Critical Strike Chance.

1416.desc_zh: 每過一段時間，下一次傷害性技能或普攻會對附近敵人觸發連鎖的閃電炸裂，造成傷害與緩速。
1416.desc_en: Periodically your next damaging Ability or Attack triggers a lightning blast, chaining through enemies to deal damage and Slow.

1420.desc_zh: 每隔[數值]秒自動輪替施放堅毅詠嘆調和迅捷奏鳴曲。 堅毅詠嘆調使鄰近友軍回復生命，並暫時獲得護盾靈氣。 迅捷奏鳴曲暫時賦予可增加跑速的靈氣。
1420.desc_en: Every [數值] seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody. Aria of Perseverence heals nearby allies and grants a temporary shielding aura. Song of Celerity grants a temporary aura that provides bonus Movement Speed.

1421.desc_zh: 每隔[數值]秒自動施放，以閃亮寶冠為自己加冕。戴上寶冠時，獲得銳空的大絕，可魅惑觸碰到的敵軍。
1421.desc_en: Every [數值] seconds, Autocast a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.

1996.desc_zh: 魔法彎刀的效果會造成額外傷害，並依目標生命的一定比例治療你。此外，可獲得250金錢。
1996.desc_en: Your Spellblade effects deal additional damage and heal you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain 250 Gold.

2004.desc_zh: 給予友軍治療或護盾時會祝福對方；他們對敵軍造成傷害時，你會獲得信仰。 累積足夠信仰時，便會發出衝擊波，造成魔法傷害並處決低生命的敵軍。
2004.desc_en: Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion. When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.

2005.desc_zh: 獲得敢死風采。煞氣等級達到S時，自動使用「地獄火狂襲」。
2005.desc_en: Gain Daredevil Impulse. When you reach S Style, automatically use Inferno Trigger.

2006.desc_zh: 普攻和技能會處決低生命的敵方英雄、造成擊退並引發爆炸，同時回復自身生命。
2006.desc_en: Your Attacks and Abilities execute low Health enemy champions, Knocking Back and causing an explosion while healing you.

2007.desc_zh: 與小惡魔本魔締結契約。 他會持續汲取你的生命，但也會獎勵你，使你對英雄造成額外真實傷害，並生成生命殘渣給你。
2007.desc_en: Forge a pact with The Little Devil himself. He drains your life over time but rewards by applying bonus true damage against champions and creating healing remnants for you to acquire.

2009.desc_zh: 增加[數值]暴擊率和[數值]攻速。
2009.desc_en: Gain [數值] Critical Strike Chance and [數值] Attack Speed.

2010.desc_zh: 暴擊額外施加一次命中效果。 增加 [數值]暴擊率。
2010.desc_en: Your Critical Strikes apply On-Hit effects an additional time. Gain [數值] Crit chance.

2016.desc_zh: 命中會消耗[數值]魔力造成[數值]魔法傷害，此傷害可暴擊。
2016.desc_en: On-Hit consume [數值] Mana to deal [數值] magic damage, this damage can Critically Strike.

2018.desc_zh: 冷卻時間減免一定百分比，並將所有攻速轉換為技能加速。
2018.desc_en: Gain percent cooldown reduction and convert all of your Attack Speed into Ability Haste.

2024.desc_zh: 獲得自身[數值]暴擊率的技能加速。
2024.desc_en: Gain Ability Haste equal to [數值] of your Critical Strike Chance.

2026.desc_zh: 跑向低生命敵軍時，增加跑速。
2026.desc_en: Gain increased Movement Speed towards enemies at low Health.

2031.desc_zh: 死亡時，一隻擁有你所有增幅裝置的巨型泰貝爾會從天而降，對鄰近敵軍造成傷害。
2031.desc_en: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.

2032.desc_zh: 死亡後幾秒內，鯊魚會撕咬所有鄰近敵軍。你在死亡後可以透過移動瞄準鯊魚攻擊。
2032.desc_en: A few seconds after death, a shark chomps all nearby enemies. You can move after death to aim the shark attack.

2034.desc_zh: 鯊魚會圍繞你的雪球盤旋，緩速並傷害鄰近敵軍。當你的雪球命中英雄時，對方會被困在鯊魚風暴中！
2034.desc_en: Sharks circle your Snowball, slowing and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!

2042.desc_zh: 進入草叢後，可造成額外[數值]傷害，持續[數值]秒。待在草叢中可重置效果。
2042.desc_en: After entering Brush, deal [數值] more damage for [數值] seconds. Remain in the Brush to refresh the effect.

2043.desc_zh: 進入草叢時，治療大量生命。
2043.desc_en: Entering Brush regenerates a large amount of Health.

2046.desc_zh: 任務：收集普羅點心並餵食[數值]普羅。 獎勵：召喚師技能「普羅衝鋒」——向敵方隊伍發射一波波超可愛又超危險的普羅。任務每升一級，就能發射更多次普羅。 「喔呵！你看看他們多可愛啊！」——普羅牧人
2046.desc_en: QUEST: Gather Poro Snax and feed [數值] Poros. REWARD: Gain the Poro Charge Summoner Spell, which launches waves of Poros at the enemy team. Additional waves unlock per Quest Level. "Oho! Look how charming they are!" — Poro Herder

2054.desc_zh: 你的{{SpellName}}會額外鎖定你前方的2名敵軍。
2054.desc_en: Your {{SpellName}} targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.

2055.desc_zh: 任務：以{{SpellName}}命中敵方英雄[數值]次。 獎勵：任務每升一級可發射額外飛彈。
2055.desc_en: QUEST: Hit enemy Champions with {{SpellName}} [數值] times. REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.

2062.desc_zh: 施放{{SpellName}}時會朝滑鼠位置製造一個分身，並重施技能。
2062.desc_en: Casting your {{SpellName}} sends a clone toward your mouse position and recasts it.

2063.desc_zh: 獲得召喚師技能「黑暗時刻」。創造一個區域，將其中所有人傳送到另一個次元。
2063.desc_en: Gain the When the Darkness Comes Summoner Spell. Create a zone that transports everyone inside of it to another dimension.

2064.desc_en: When you use {{SpellName}}, dash towards your cursor.

2065.desc_zh: 施放{{SpellName}}時，使周圍敵軍陷入恐懼。
2065.desc_en: Whenever you cast {{SpellName}}, Fear enemies around you.

2072.desc_zh: 你的{{SpellName}}飛彈在命中、達到最遠距離或重施技能時會分裂成兩發。
2072.desc_en: Your {{SpellName}} missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when Recast.

2073.desc_zh: 以{{SpellName}}對敵方英雄造成傷害時，會治療自身。
2073.desc_en: Damaging enemy champions with {{SpellName}} heals you.

2076.desc_zh: {{Spellname}}對敵方英雄造成傷害時，增加[數值]物防和魔防。
2076.desc_en: When {{Spellname}} damages enemy champions, gain [數值] Armor and Magic Resistance.

2077.desc_zh: 以{{SpellName}}對敵方英雄施加硬控場或禁錮時造成額外傷害，並使你回復生命。
2077.desc_en: Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champions with {{SpellName}} deals extra damage and heals you.

2078.desc_zh: 如果目標被{{SpellName}}擊退時撞到另一位英雄，該英雄會被擊飛並受到傷害。如果撞擊地形，則延長擊飛時間並造成額外傷害。
2078.desc_en: If a target Knocked Back by {{SpellName}} hits another champion, they are Knocked Up and dealt damage. When colliding with terrain, the Knock Up duration is extended and they are dealt bonus damage.

2080.desc_zh: 重施雪球會造成更高的傷害，擊飛目標，並擊退鄰近敵軍。
2080.desc_en: Recasting Snowball deals increased damage, Knocks Up the target, and Knocks Back nearby enemies.

2082.desc_zh: 當其他人在你周圍接受治療時，你也會獲得其中[數值]的治療效果。來自敵軍的治療效果加倍。
2082.desc_en: Whenever someone heals around you, you heal [數值] of their own healing. Doubled from Enemy healing.

2083.desc_zh: 暴擊敵軍會掉落牙齒。撿起牙齒會永久獲得物理致命和魔法穿透。
2083.desc_en: Bursting enemies drops Teeth. Picking up Teeth grants you permanent Lethality and Magic Penetration.

2087.desc_zh: 施放技能時，會返還另一個隨機技能的費用，數值為原始技能冷卻時間的[數值]。
2087.desc_en: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by [數值] of the original spell's Cooldown.

2088.desc_zh: 你的雪球獲得100技能加速。命中敵軍時會造成額外魔法傷害。若你沒有雪球，則你獲得一顆雪球。
2088.desc_en: Gain 100 Ability Haste on your Snowball. It deals additional magic damage when hitting an enemy. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

2089.desc_zh: 參與擊殺敵方英雄時，敵方英雄會在附近掉落金幣，供你和隊友撿取。每枚金幣值[數值]金錢。
2089.desc_en: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth [數值] gold.

2091.desc_zh: 戰鬥時，自動施放圓形斧擊，造成物理傷害。外圈的敵軍會受到額外傷害，並讓你回復生命。
2091.desc_en: While in combat, Autocast a circular axe that deals physical damage. Enemies on the outer edge take additional damage and heal you.

2095.desc_zh: 鄰近敵軍在死亡時有機會掉落能力值鐵砧。
2095.desc_en: Nearby enemies have a chance to drop Stat Anvils on death.

2096.desc_zh: 在{{SpellName}}持續期間增加[數值]攻擊距離和[數值]攻速。
2096.desc_en: Gain [數值] Attack Range and [數值] Attack Speed during your {{SpellName}} duration.

2097.desc_zh: 使用{{Spellname}}衝刺時會生成一個虛空區域，緩速敵方英雄並造成魔法傷害。
2097.desc_en: Dashing with {{Spellname}} spawns a Void Zone that Slows enemy champions and deals magic damage.

2098.desc_zh: 定期找出敵方英雄的破綻。用普攻或技能擊中破綻時，造成最大生命的真實傷害、回復自身生命並增加跑速。這些效果可累加。
2098.desc_en: Periodically identify Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals max Health true damage, restores Health, and grants Movement Speed. These effects can stack.

2099.desc_zh: 參與擊殺時，敵方英雄會留下精華。攻擊精華會獲得跑速，並重置基礎技能冷卻時間。
2099.desc_en: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants movement speed and resets basic ability cooldowns.

2100.desc_zh: 任務：以{{SpellName}}命中敵方英雄[數值]次。 獎勵：任務每升一級，{{SpellName}}獲得技能加速，最多獲得[數值]。
2100.desc_en: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with {{SpellName}} [數值] times. REWARD: Gain Ability Haste on {{SpellName}} per Quest Level up to [數值].

2102.desc_zh: 每秒對鄰近敵方英雄附加一層燃燒，傷害隨你的最大生命成長。 任務：對敵方英雄造成燃燒傷害。 獎勵：任務每升一級，提升體型和傷害。
2102.desc_en: Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health. QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions. REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.

2103.desc_zh: 任務：用技能狙擊[數值]名敵方英雄 獎勵：召喚隕石砸向你狙擊的敵方英雄，對其周圍區域造成魔法傷害
2103.desc_en: QUEST: Snipe [數值] enemy champions with abilities REWARD: Send a meteor at Sniped enemy champions, dealing Magic damage in an area around them

2104.desc_zh: 對友方英雄進行治療和護盾會累積靈魂炸彈。滿層時，將該炸彈丟到生命最低的友軍身上，為其及附近友軍提供治療並護盾。
2104.desc_en: Healing and Shielding allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto lowest Health ally to heal and shield them and nearby allies.

2107.desc_zh: 透過普攻或技能傷害敵方英雄會賦予層數。滿層後，死亡時會復活並獲得強化。
2107.desc_en: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you revive empowered upon death.

2109.desc_zh: 重施技能{{SpellName}}會引爆並返回你原本的位置。
2109.desc_en: Recast {{SpellName}} to explode and return to your original position.

2111.desc_zh: 以{{SpellName}}強化的普攻與技能，會對目標與鄰近敵軍造成額外傷害。
2111.desc_en: Attacks and Abilities empowered by {{SpellName}} deal additional damage to the target and nearby enemies.

2115.desc_zh: 偶爾會向所有鄰近敵方英雄甩出黏呼呼的巴掌，束縛他們。下一次普攻會將所有被束縛的敵軍拉向你。
2115.desc_en: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.

2116.desc_zh: 任務：以{{SpellName}}命中敵方英雄[數值]次。 獎勵：永久提升{{SpellName}}傷害
2116.desc_en: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with {{SpellName}} [數值] times. REWARD: Permanently increase {{SpellName}} damage.

2118.desc_zh: 你的技能加速只能套用於大絕，但效果提升50%。獲得100技能加速。
2118.desc_en: Your Ability Haste only applies to your Ultimate, but is 50% more effective. Gain 100 Ability Haste.

2119.desc_zh: 回城進入你的砲擊發射器。它的射程、砲彈速度和傷害都大幅提升。
2119.desc_en: Recall to enter your Cannon Launcher. It has significantly increased range, travel speed, and damage.

2123.desc_zh: 使用其他技能會重置{{SpellName}}的冷卻時間。
2123.desc_en: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of {{SpellName}}.

2125.desc_zh: 發動{{SpellName}}會在持續期間賦予自身跑速。
2125.desc_en: Activating {{SpellName}} grants you Movement Speed for its duration.

2127.desc_zh: 道具與增幅裝置的傷害提升[數值]。
2127.desc_en: Increase your Item and Augment damage by [數值].

2128.desc_zh: 對英雄造成的燃燒和持續傷害效果會產生金錢。
2128.desc_en: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate gold.

2129.desc_zh: 你的{{SpellName}}在其周圍造成範圍傷害。
2129.desc_en: Your {{SpellName}} deals damage in an area around it.

2131.desc_en: Gain a Shield for every second you spend Channeling.

2133.desc_zh: 使用{{SpellName}}治療或給予護盾友軍後，你的下一次普攻將增加攻擊距離和攻速，並造成額外最大生命魔法傷害。
2133.desc_en: After healing or shielding your ally with {{SpellName}}, your next basic attack gains attack range, attack speed and deals bonus max Health magic damage.

2134.desc_zh: 施放大絕時，生成一個區域，為你提供技能加速和跑速。在裡面時，會發射飛彈，造成等同於你[數值]的傷害。
2134.desc_en: On Ultimate cast, spawn a Zone that grants Ability Haste and Movement Speed. While inside, it fires missiles that deal [數值] of your damage.

2135.desc_zh: 在{{SpellName}}期間普攻會用刺釘撕裂你的目標。釘刺會累積傷害、處決目標，並在結束時賦予跑速。
2135.desc_en: Attacks during {{SpellName}} gouge your target with Nails. Nails accumulate damage, execute, and grant Movement Speed upon expiration.

2136.desc_zh: 以{{SpellName}}命中敵方英雄會締結友誼羈絆。 {{SpellName}}會根據你的友誼等級暫時提升傷害。
2136.desc_en: Striking enemy champions with {{SpellName}} forges a bond of Friendship. {{SpellName}} gains temporarily increased damage based on your level of Friendship.

2137.desc_zh: 經過友軍身旁時，對方會鼓勵你，賦予你護盾和跑速。
2137.desc_en: Allies encourage you when you walk past, granting you a Shield and Movement Speed.

2138.desc_zh: 以{{SpellName}}擊中敵方英雄時，根據其傷害類型，賦予你[數值]物防或魔防，持續[數值]秒。此效果可累加。
2138.desc_en: Striking an enemy champion with {{SpellName}} grants you [數值] Armor or Magic Resist based on their damage type for [數值] seconds. This effect can stack.

2139.desc_zh: 受到英雄傷害時，會匯聚細針然後向四周爆裂，對鄰近敵軍造成傷害和緩速效果。
2139.desc_en: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles that fly out of you, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

2140.desc_zh: 技能命中時，對敵軍觸發劈砍。狂怒九頭蛇的普攻吸血提升至[數值] 獲得[數值]金錢。
2140.desc_en: Your spell hits trigger Cleave against enemies. Increase Ravenous Hydra's Life Steal to [數值] Gain [數值] Gold.

2141.desc_zh: 合成一件九頭蛇道具時，獲得一把海神之斧。 任務：持有狂怒九頭蛇、瀆神九頭蛇和泰坦九頭蛇。 獎勵：獲得究極九頭蛇。
2141.desc_en: Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item. QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra. REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.

2143.desc_zh: 突破天際對每個目標的冷卻時間縮短至[數值]秒，並治療自身[數值]已損失生命。 獲得[數值]金錢。
2143.desc_en: Reduce Sundered Sky's per target cooldown to [數值] seconds and heal you for [數值] of missing health. Gain [數值] Gold.

2144.desc_zh: {{SpellName}}賦予的護盾量增強，且會隨目標的已損失生命而提升。
2144.desc_en: Shields granted from {{SpellName}} are stronger and scaling with target's missing Health.

2148.desc_en: {{SpellName}} applies {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects an additional time.

2157.desc_zh: 獲得 [數值]金錢。 [數值]所受傷害會分攤在數秒內承受。 參與擊殺時立即獲得更多治療。
2157.desc_en: Gain [數值]. [數值] of damage taken is dealt to you overtime. Heal for more instantly when scoring a takedown.

12317.desc_zh: 將所有的增幅裝置物轉化為隨機稜鏡增幅裝置。
12317.desc_en: Transmute all of your augments into random Prismatic Augments.
